sourceCoverage.rationale: Full retained machine source argument and eleven topic cues were independently reviewed on prior head; unchanged analytical prose and cues are now contained in eleven proper semantic sections. Source-aid manifest identity is corrected; map schema remains a separate integration gap.

supportingArgument.rationale: Source-first thesis and eleven failures and interventions are ordered faithfully. GhostMesh distinguishes modifying existing work habits from constructing a new framework.

evidenceRoles.rationale: Creator recommendations, sponsored product claims, vendor guidance and framework documentation remain distinct. No source-specific controlled effectiveness or independent payoff replication is claimed.

counterargument.rationale: New hooks and skills can worsen the sprawl they try to fix. A hook protects only the actual event and access paths it intercepts; broader security requires effective tool/service permission boundaries.

tradeoffs.rationale: Independent review, subagents, handoffs and validation all have effort and context costs. The manuscript pairs each intervention with its actual failure rather than recommending blanket adoption.

falsifiability.rationale: The proposed next ordinary task comparison tracks scope, owner interventions, elapsed time, extra mechanisms and observed defects, while acknowledging task/source differences. It is not an executed causal experiment.

originalSynthesis.rationale: The small-fix premise becomes a practical selection rule: choose the smallest existing enforceable correction to an observed failure and stop expanding authority or scope.

performance.rationale: The video supplies recommendations and examples, not controlled defect rates or repeated before/after outcomes. Browser checks establish this Reader’s UI behavior, not the source workflow payoff.

economics.rationale: Subagent and testing costs are discussed without invented savings. Cost and delay must be assessed alongside quality and avoidable owner intervention.

threatGovernance.rationale: Human decisions and downstream authorization remain separate from prose rules or isolated hooks. Draft relationship projection and final production authority are explicitly distinguished.

gaps.rationale: Prior machine-ASR and unreplicated-effectiveness limits are unchanged; this bounded review is not new source certification.
